hypothesised_pattern: Targets are underpredicted when x2*x5 > 0 or |x4| is very large, and overpredicted when x2*x5 < 0, which points to a missing bilinear x2*x5 term plus an even x4 term.
rationale: All seven negative-residual rows (targets 0.25-0.45) have x2*x5 < 0 (about -0.26 to -1.83), and the three positive-residual rows (targets 0.60-0.83) have x2*x5 > 0 (about 0.15, 0.62, 1.72). The weakest positive product (row 1, 0.986*0.148) comes with x4 = -2.537, so the large-|x4| quadratic effect appears to make up the rest of that residual.
